result.summary: Selected synthetic offer-G through the registered SelectOffer proposal, binding request G revision 1 and offer-G revision 1. Its 20 cups of 350 ml standard-milk latte, destination B, complete firm total of CNY 465, and delivery commitment by 2026-10-19T11:00:00.000Z satisfy the fixed comparison constraints. Registered matching, freshness and all four hard precondition checks passed. The cheaper offer-X has unknown capacity; offer-Y has incomplete fee coverage. Inspected the returned proposed changes: Proposal, Proposal.selectedOffer and ServiceRequest.selectedProposal. All five submission checks passed. The provider participation records a synthetic fulfiller role; seller identity and the participation’s association with the selected channel remain unverified. Execution permission remains unknown and is not granted by this proposal. The host returned proposal_only and executionAllowed=false. Nothing executed; all supporting evidence is synthetic and establishes no real supply, payment or fulfillment.
